text:
ajay: FYI — KMS policy push at 07:00UTC triggered a firewall rule change that blocked outbound connections for the batch-provisioner in eu-west-1. ~35 GPU nodes failed to complete bootstrap. hitting autoscaler hot path.

maria: seeing the same, CI logs show TLS handshake timeouts to kms-secondary:443 and S3 PUTs for node-state.

tess: any quick rollback option? can we patch the firewall rule to allow the batch-provisioner SG until we sort the policy? :pray:

ajay: rollback is possible but it's gated by the security rollout plan. quick alternative: add the batch-provisioner node role to the allowed egress CIDR for 1hr as a temporary exception. patching the rule id fw-eu-71a.

devops-bot: deploy request queued: patch-firewall fw-eu-71a add-egress-allow role=batch-provisioner ttl=3600 by @ajay — awaiting approvals.

ian: re: audit logs — because the policy change touched KMS grants we need to snapshot KMS key audit events for the window (07:00-07:10). otherwise compliance will flag missing event correlation.

leila: grabbing VPC flow logs and CloudTrail slice now. quick query I ran:
```
fields @timestamp, srcAddr, dstAddr, action, bytes
| filter dstAddr contains "kms" or dstAddr contains "s3"
| filter @timestamp between 2026-03-15T07:00:00 and 2026-03-15T07:12:00
| stats count() by action, srcAddr
```
returned a spike in REJECT for the provisioner subnets.

sam: cost note — failed bootstraps still incur instance reservation time for warm pools; estimate ~120 GPU-hours wasted across the region. we should flag for finance to avoid surprise.

maria: quick mitigation applied: @ajay added exception, nodes are re-attempting join. current bootstrap success is ~80% and climbing.

ajay: patch reverted the strict deny temporarily. need a permanent fix: two options — (A) update KMS rollout gating to not remove the allowlist for provisioner egress, (B) move provisioner to use a privatelink endpoint for KMS and S3 so firewall rules don't need to be widened.

leila: leaning toward (B) long-term. privatelink gives auditable path and reduces blast radius. downside: infra work and some per-endpoint costs.

ian: also propose adding a canary step to policy rollouts: a small traffic test that exercises provisioning flows and checks audit correlation before full rollout. saves us from these mid-rollout surprises.

devops-bot: canary-run scheduled: policy-rollout-canary-1768240001 -> 07:20UTC, targets: 5 nodes, timeout 10m.

tess: please record an incident note for security/compliance and tag the KMS owners. we need the audit snapshot attached to the RCA.

ajay: filing incident doc /incidents/1768240001-kms-firewall-eu-provision.json with initial timeline and attaching logs. action items: 1) Privatelink feasibility study (leila), 2) Rollout gating updates + canary (ian), 3) Finance estimate for wasted GPU-hours (sam), 4) Add provisioner to approved egress list in emergency runbook (maria).

maria: noted. I'll also update the runbook with the exact ip ranges and rule ids to avoid confusion next time.

sam: tagging @finance-head per runbook for cost recovery discussion.

leila: saving VPC+CloudTrail slices to s3://redwood-ops-archives/incidents/1768240001/. set retention 90d as requested by compliance.

ajay: thanks all. once incident doc has RCA draft we can close the thread. :thumbsup:
